name: NDL PubSec MCP data exchanges feed
about: Data exchanges between UK public sector organisations, each tied to the journey it serves, with the parties, what flows, how, the shared identifiers and standards involved, and sources. Read-only and descriptive: this server never takes part in any exchange.
caution: relatedApis are found by keyword search of the government API catalogue when the feed is built. A related API is not evidence that the exchange uses it. The register counts agreements, not volume, and records one method per agreement, so API use there is a floor.

register.title: Register of information sharing agreements under chapters 1 to 4 of Part 5 of the Digital Economy Act 2017
register.limits: Covers only agreements under the Digital Economy Act 2017, Part 5; 473 of the 667 have ended, many of them 2019 to 2020 pilots, and 204 are near-identical agreements between DWP and individual energy suppliers for one scheme. It counts agreements, not how much data moves or how often. The largest flows, such as payroll data for Universal Credit and Tell Us Once, run under other legal gateways and are not in it, and much cross-government sharing runs over APIs that the register's single method field does not show. Organisation names were grouped by this server (for example, every energy supplier as 'Energy suppliers'). Contact details on the register were not copied.
byPower: Public service delivery: early learning and childcare
register.methodField: Each agreement records exactly one 'information sharing method'. It is the main method declared for the agreement, not every route used: agreements 205, 284 and 663 (the Warm Home Discount helpline, 2022 to 2027) record trusted partner transfer, encrypted hardware or secure file transfer, yet their disclosed-information text says electronic access to DWP's Citizen Application Programming Interface (CAPI) will also be enabled. So API counts from this field are a floor.

context.claim: DWP reported demand for its data from other government departments rising from 4.5 million to over 7.5 million API requests a day at peak, all routed through its API gateway

source.title: How APIs kept our country running when everything stopped (DWP Digital blog, 8 December 2021)

exchanges.title: Earnings from payroll to Universal Credit
exchanges.flows: Pay As You Earn earnings reported by employers in real time (RTI) for Universal Credit claimants
exchanges.purpose: Calculate each monthly Universal Credit award from actual earnings
exchanges.mechanism: DWP's Real Time Earnings system requests RTI data from HMRC for claimants several times a day; DWP passes some PAYE data on to local authorities for Housing Benefit
exchanges.scale: RTI covers more than 40 million employees and occupational pensioners (HMRC post-implementation review, 2017, as reported)
exchanges.legalBasis: Universal Credit regulations direct DWP to use RTI data for employed earnings (revenuebenefits.org.uk, search-sourced)

sources.title: Real Time Information, DWP guidance (deposited paper DEP2024-0673)
HMRC PAYE manual PAYE5001: RTI introduction
Written evidence UCU0094 to the Work and Pensions Committee

exchanges.title: Report a death once to many services
exchanges.flows: Notification of a death and the details needed to stop benefits, cancel a passport and driving licence, and update council services
exchanges.purpose: Spare bereaved people from telling each organisation separately
exchanges.mechanism: The registrar gives a Tell Us Once reference; the service, run by DWP, notifies the organisations the informant consents to
exchanges.scale: 2.4 million notifications to partner organisations from 399,000 uses in 2017 to 2018 (Civil Service Local blog, 2018)
exchanges.notes: Not available if the person lived in Northern Ireland or abroad (mygov.scot).

sources.title: Tell Us Once on mygov.scot
A spotlight on Tell Us Once (Civil Service Local blog)

exchanges.title: Birth, death and marriage registrations shared with services
exchanges.flows: Birth, death, marriage and civil partnership registration details, and NHS numbers linked with births and deaths
exchanges.purpose: Keep benefit, passport and health records right without the citizen having to tell each one
exchanges.mechanism: Civil registration powers in Part 5 of the Digital Economy Act; many agreements use electronic verification
exchanges.scale: 50 agreements under the civil registration power on the register
exchanges.legalBasis: Digital Economy Act 2017, Part 5, Chapter 2 (civil registration)

exchanges.title: Help with energy bills: benefit data matched for suppliers
exchanges.flows: Whether a customer gets a qualifying benefit, matched against suppliers' customer lists
exchanges.purpose: Give eligible households the Warm Home Discount without them having to apply
exchanges.mechanism: Data matching; agreements use encrypted email and secure platforms
exchanges.scale: 326 agreements under the fuel poverty power: the largest group on the register (204 DWP with energy suppliers, 70 DESNZ with energy suppliers)
exchanges.legalBasis: Digital Economy Act 2017, Part 5, public service delivery: fuel poverty
exchanges.notes: The helpline agreements (205, 284, 663) also enable electronic access to DWP's Citizen API, although their recorded method is file-based.
